market_brief: Nvidia's beat is lifting US futures (Nasdaq 100 ~+1%) after Tuesday's S&P 500 -1.0% and Dow -1.6% left the index at a July low and the VIX at ~25.5 (+11%). The bigger cross-asset story today is hawkish rate pricing: a December Fed hike is ~95% priced ahead of tonight's minutes, the BoE (~90%) and BoJ (~85%) are also seen hiking, and the 10Y is ~5.10% with DXY ~103.7 near a 19-month high. That is crushing metals (gold -2.3% to ~$3,775, silver -3%, copper -2.8%) and helped push the Nifty down ~0.8% on metal-stock losses, while oil fell ~2% (WTI ~$84) on an API build despite another Hormuz attack. Retail earnings were solid (Target, Lowe's beat), and Anthropic prices its IPO after the US close.
ai_brief: Anthropic's IPO pricing tonight dominates, with reports pointing above the $70-78 range ahead of Thursday's ANT debut. Nvidia confirmed it is ending H200 sales to China while Washington reportedly prepares an 'AI national champions' list. AMD closed its $8.2B World Labs deal, Microsoft's Ignite pushed Copilot agents, and funding stayed heavy (Isomorphic Labs, Humyn Labs).

items.headline: US futures rebound after Nvidia beat; Nasdaq 100 futures up ~0.8-1.1%
items.summary: After two losing sessions that left the S&P 500 at its lowest close since July, Nasdaq 100 futures rose roughly 1% and S&P futures 0.3-0.6% pre-market, led by Nvidia (~+3%), AMD, Broadcom and neocloud names; Dow futures were near flat.

items.headline: Target Q3 beats: comps +5.6%, sales +7.1% to $27.1B, but shares slip
items.summary: Target's diluted EPS of $2.65 topped the ~$2.08 estimate, though it includes a $0.50 boost from tariff refunds; digital comps rose 9.8%. Shares still traded lower pre-market.

items.headline: Lowe's beats estimates and raises full-year sales outlook
items.summary: Lowe's topped Q3 expectations on strong online sales and lifted its annual sales forecast despite a sluggish housing market; reports note cost pressures persist.

items.headline: Markets price ~94-96% odds of a December Fed hike ahead of minutes
items.summary: Futures imply a near-certain 25bp hike at the Dec 8-9 FOMC (a small chance of 50bp), with the 2Y at ~4.79% and 10Y at ~5.10%. October FOMC minutes are due at 19:00 GMT today.

items.headline: Metals rout: gold -2.4% to ~$3,778, silver and copper down ~3.6-3.8%
items.summary: Rate-hike pricing and a firm dollar hit precious and base metals; gold broke below $3,800 and LME copper fell 3.6% to $12,763/t. Fresnillo, Antofagasta and Endeavour fell ~4% in London.

items.headline: Update on UK CPI: FTSE 100 -0.4% on miners; ~90% odds of a December BoE hike
items.summary: After October CPI printed 3.6% (core 2.8%, services 3.7%), the FTSE fell on commodity stocks and sterling slipped 0.3% to ~$1.317. Markets were cited pricing about a 90% chance of a BoE hike in December.

items.headline: BoJ's Ueda signals more hikes; USD/JPY hovers just below 160
items.summary: Ueda said the BoJ will keep raising rates depending on data, with December hike odds put near 85% despite a 0.1% annualised Q3 GDP contraction. USD/JPY sat near 159.4, with intervention warnings capping it.

items.headline: India closes lower: Sensex sheds ~500 points, Nifty near 25,230; metals lead losses
items.summary: Profit-taking after a recent rally and a slump in metal stocks (Nifty Metal -2.5%) dragged benchmarks ~0.6%; Titan, HDFC Life and Hindalco were among top losers while SBI and Cipla gained. Update: earlier session dip extended into the close.

items.headline: Oil slips ~1.6-2% on API build; new Hormuz vessel attack limits losses
items.summary: Brent eased toward ~$91.7 and WTI ~$83 after a 5.3M-barrel API crude build. ADNOC reported a vessel attacked in the Strait of Hormuz overnight, with 11 crew injured and one missing.

items.headline: Nvidia stops H200 sales to China; Jefferies sizes export-rule hit at $44-62B
items.summary: Nvidia is ending H200 shipments to China, and Jefferies estimated new export controls could cut $44B-$62B of potential revenue; interim CEO Colette Kress says the Vera Rubin backlog cushions the impact.

items.headline: SemiAnalysis reportedly cuts 2028 AI-accelerator spend forecast by 28%
items.summary: Per a market newsletter, SemiAnalysis lowered its 2028 global accelerator spend estimate from about $1.05T to $758B, with later-year cuts of up to ~40%, a counterpoint to Nvidia's strong guide.

items.headline: BofA fund manager survey: tech overweight slashed; record share say firms overinvest in AI
items.summary: The November survey reportedly shows net tech overweight falling from 37% to 12%, the biggest monthly cut since 2006, and a record net 38% saying companies are overinvesting in AI.

items.headline: Lutnick reportedly to name 20+ US AI firms 'national champions'
items.summary: Per a WSJ report cited in a market newsletter, Commerce Secretary Lutnick plans to designate more than two dozen US AI companies as national champions; details were not confirmed.

items.headline: Trump in Shenzhen for APEC ahead of talks with Xi and Putin
items.summary: The APEC summit runs Wednesday-Thursday; Iran, Ukraine and AI cooperation are reportedly on the agenda, with markets watching for trade-truce deliverables ahead of a January deadline.

items.headline: Ramp reportedly in talks to raise $1B+ at a $70B+ valuation
items.summary: The fintech is in early talks with Coatue and Thrive reportedly leading, a month after a $60B round; annualised revenue reportedly topped $2B in October.

items.headline: 13F chatter: Duquesne holds SpaceX; Situational Awareness cuts long book ~92%
items.summary: Fintwit is parsing 13Fs: Druckenmiller's Duquesne reportedly disclosed ~$30.5M of SpaceX shares, while Leopold Aschenbrenner's fund reportedly cut its reported long book by about 92%.

items.headline: Next 36h: FOMC minutes (19:00 GMT), Anthropic IPO pricing, PANW/TJX; ANT debut Thu
items.summary: Fed October minutes land today, Anthropic prices its IPO after the US close with Nasdaq trading Thursday, and APEC continues. Further out: Fed Dec 8-9 and BoJ Dec 17-18.

items.headline: Update: Anthropic prices 825M-share IPO tonight; reports point above $70-78 range
items.summary: Pricing is expected this evening with Nasdaq trading as ANT from Thursday; sources cited in newsletters say demand supports a price above the range. What changed: pricing is now hours away.

items.headline: US 'AI national champions' plan reported as Nvidia ends H200 China shipments
items.summary: Per WSJ via a newsletter, Commerce plans to designate 20+ US AI firms as national champions, while Nvidia confirmed no more H200s will ship to China under tighter export rules.

items.headline: AMD completes $8.2B World Labs deal; Fei-Fei Li becomes Chief Scientist
items.summary: AMD closed its all-stock acquisition of the world-model startup, issuing ~15M shares, and named Fei-Fei Li EVP and Chief Scientist.

items.headline: Ignite: Word, Excel, PowerPoint GA inside Copilot; new 'Autopilot' persistent agent
items.summary: Microsoft pitched Copilot as the OS for work, adding Office apps inside Copilot, a Microsoft IQ context layer and an Autopilot agent billed in Copilot Credits; a Salesforce-in-Copilot plugin also entered preview.

items.headline: Nvidia open-sources NVKE/NVKR for managed GPU Kubernetes (Apache 2.0)
items.summary: The control plane and node-image builder are in public preview; reviewers flagged that the default API listens without authentication, so hardening is needed.

items.headline: SC26: Nvidia unveils Nemotron for Science agent toolkit, runnable on DGX Spark
items.summary: Ian Buck's keynote also expanded Rubin/Vera HPC offerings and a quantum co-design platform with IBM and Fermilab.

items.headline: AMD Instinct MI350P comes to Windows Server with inference microservices
items.summary: AMD said the MI350P will support Windows Server 2025 and 2028 with GPU partitioning and AMD Inference Microservices at launch.

items.headline: Bengaluru's Humyn Labs raises $47M led by Accel for robotics training data
items.summary: The round mixes $26M equity (Accel, Prosus, Bajaj entities, Jump Trading) and $21M venture debt; the firm records real-world tasks in 20+ countries and reported ~$10M revenue in Apr-Oct.

items.headline: Funding roll: Isomorphic Labs $5B Series C; Corma $125M at $1B; LanceDB $57.5M
items.summary: Newsletters list a heavy day of AI raises, led by DeepMind spin-out Isomorphic Labs' reported $5B round; terms were not independently verified.

items.headline: Bank CEOs and NSA tell Congress outages stemmed from rush to patch AI-found bugs
items.summary: Testimony reportedly linked recent outages, including an FAA ground stop, to systems overwhelmed by emergency patching of AI-discovered vulnerabilities.
